noEffort.zh: 当前模型未提供推理等级。
noEffort.en: This model offers no reasoning levels.

deepseek-flash.zh: 最新旗舰 Flash：百万上下文，长程 Agent 的 KV 缓存成本降到约 1/4。
deepseek-flash.en: Latest flagship Flash: 1M context with the KV-cache cost of long-horizon agents cut to about a quarter.

deepseek-v4-flash.zh: 快速、高效、经济；适合目标明确、常规或并行任务。
deepseek-v4-flash.en: Fast, efficient, and economical; suited to focused, routine, or parallel tasks.

deepseek-v4-pro.zh: 自主编码、知识与复杂推理更强；适合质量优先的复杂任务，成本更高。
deepseek-v4-pro.en: Stronger agentic coding, knowledge, and difficult reasoning; suited to complex or quality-critical tasks at higher cost.

deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp.zh: 实验性多模态：视觉理解大幅补强，多模态 Agent 能力接近 Opus-4.8。
deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp.en: Experimental multimodal Flash: much stronger visual understanding, multimodal agent ability approaching Opus-4.8.

deepseek-v3.2.zh: 上一代通用模型，长上下文与成本仍然能打。
deepseek-v3.2.en: Previous-generation generalist; still competitive on long context and cost.

claude-opus-4.8.zh: 旗舰：编程、Agent 与专业工作最强，长程任务一致性最好。
claude-opus-4.8.en: Flagship: strongest coding, agentic and professional work, with the consistency for long-running tasks.

claude-sonnet-5.zh: 主力档：成本与能力平衡，部分场景追平 Opus。
claude-sonnet-5.en: The workhorse: balanced cost and capability, matching Opus in some cases.

gpt-5.4.zh: 前沿通用模型，首个原生电脑操作能力，整合 Codex 编码能力。
gpt-5.4.en: Frontier generalist with native computer use and Codex-grade coding.

gemini-3.8-flash.zh: 最强 Flash：跑分直逼旗舰，强化编程、Agent 与多步推理，价格仍低。
gemini-3.8-flash.en: The strongest Flash: benchmark scores near flagship, with reinforced coding, agent workflows and multi-step reasoning.

glm-5.3.zh: 前沿编码能力，擅长长程自主任务。
glm-5.3.en: Frontier coding with strong long-horizon autonomy.

glm-5.3-flash.zh: GLM-5 系列首个原生多模态；18B 激活，性能追平 Opus-4.8，成本极低。
glm-5.3-flash.en: The GLM-5 series' first natively multimodal model; 18B active, matching Opus-4.8 at very low cost.

kimi-k3.zh: 开放 3T 级模型：原生视觉、百万上下文，编程与知识工作强。
kimi-k3.en: Open 3T-class model: native vision, 1M context, strong at coding and knowledge work.

kimi-for-coding.zh: 编程专用：稳定、便宜，适合日常改代码。
kimi-for-coding.en: Coding-tuned: steady and cheap for everyday code work.

kimi-for-coding-highspeed.zh: 与 K2.7 Code 同一模型，输出约 5–6 倍速，单价约 2 倍。
kimi-for-coding-highspeed.en: Same model as K2.7 Code at roughly 5–6x output speed and 2x the price.

qwen3.8-max.zh: 通义旗舰：多模态与综合能力最强。
qwen3.8-max.en: Qwen's flagship: strongest multimodality and overall capability.

step-5-preview.zh: 阶跃下一代旗舰预览，百万上下文。
step-5-preview.en: StepFun's next-generation flagship preview with a million-token context.

step-3.7-flash.zh: 原生多模态，超高速：约 400 token/s，目前最快的一档。
step-3.7-flash.en: Natively multimodal and extremely fast: around 400 tokens/s.

minimax-m3.zh: 编程与 Agent 前沿，百万上下文，原生多模态。
minimax-m3.en: Coding and agentic frontier with 1M context and native multimodality.

grok-4.5.zh: xAI 最强模型，主打编程。
grok-4.5.en: xAI's strongest model, aimed at programming.

doubao-seed-2.1.zh: 字节旗舰系列，分层定位，中文与多模态均衡。
doubao-seed-2.1.en: ByteDance's flagship line, tiered, balanced across Chinese and multimodality.

ernie-5.0.zh: 超稀疏 MoE，预训练成本极低，中文知识强。
ernie-5.0.en: Ultra-sparse MoE with very low training cost and strong Chinese knowledge.

mistral-large-3.zh: 宽松许可的开源权重模型，综合能力强。
mistral-large-3.en: Permissively licensed open-weight model with strong overall capability.

families.note: Anchored on `deepseek` on purpose: an unanchored /flash$/ would hand this copy to glm-5.3-flash, step-3.7-flash and every other vendor's flash tier.

text.zh: DeepSeek 推理专用：先思考再作答，适合数学、算法与难题。
text.en: DeepSeek reasoning-first: thinks before answering; best for math, algorithms and hard problems.

text.zh: DeepSeek 通用模型：中文与代码均衡，长上下文性价比高。
text.en: DeepSeek generalist: balanced Chinese and code, strong long-context value.

text.zh: Claude 旗舰：编程、Agent 与专业工作最强，长程一致性最好。
text.en: Claude flagship: strongest coding, agentic and professional work, best long-run consistency.

text.zh: Claude 主力档：成本与能力平衡，日常首选。
text.en: Claude workhorse: balanced cost and capability, the everyday default.

text.zh: Claude 轻量档：低延迟、低成本，适合简单与高频任务。
text.en: Claude lightweight: low latency and cost for simple, high-frequency tasks.

text.zh: Anthropic Claude 模型。
text.en: Anthropic Claude model.

text.zh: OpenAI 编码专用：长程代码任务与重构。
text.en: OpenAI coding specialist for long-horizon code work and refactors.

text.zh: OpenAI 通用前沿模型，推理与编码均衡。
text.en: OpenAI frontier generalist with balanced reasoning and coding.

text.zh: OpenAI 推理专用：先思考再作答，适合数学、算法与难题。
text.en: OpenAI reasoning-first: thinks before answering; best for math, algorithms and hard problems.

text.zh: OpenAI 通用模型。
text.en: OpenAI general model.

text.zh: Gemini 旗舰：世界知识与多模态最强，适合复杂长程任务。
text.en: Gemini flagship: strongest world knowledge and multimodality for complex, long-horizon work.

text.zh: Gemini Flash：快而便宜，能力逼近旗舰。
text.en: Gemini Flash: fast and cheap, with capability close to the flagship.

text.zh: Google Gemini 模型。
text.en: Google Gemini model.

text.zh: GLM Flash：原生多模态，小激活、极低成本，性能逼近旗舰。
text.en: GLM Flash: natively multimodal, few active parameters, very low cost, capability near the flagship.

text.zh: 智谱 GLM：结构化输出与编码能力突出，适合 Agent 工作流。
text.en: Zhipu GLM: strong structured output and coding, well suited to agent workflows.

text.zh: Moonshot Kimi：长文本见长，中文写作与知识工作强。
text.en: Moonshot Kimi: strong on long documents, Chinese writing and knowledge work.

text.zh: Qwen 代码专用：补全、生成与仓库级修改。
text.en: Qwen coding specialist for completion, generation and repo-level edits.

text.zh: Qwen 轻量档：响应快、成本低。
text.en: Qwen lightweight tier: fast responses at low cost.

text.zh: Qwen 中端档：能力与成本折中。
text.en: Qwen mid tier: a middle ground between capability and cost.

text.zh: 小尺寸稠密模型：可本地或低成本部署。
text.en: Small dense model: cheap to serve, or run locally.

text.zh: 阿里通义千问：中文与多模态均衡。
text.en: Alibaba Qwen: balanced Chinese and multimodality.

text.zh: 阶跃星辰 Step 模型。
text.en: StepFun Step model.

text.zh: MiniMax：性价比高，编程与长上下文兼顾。
text.en: MiniMax: good value, covering coding and long context.

text.zh: xAI Grok：风格直接，编程与实时知识强。
text.en: xAI Grok: direct style, strong at coding and current knowledge.

text.zh: 字节豆包：中文与多模态均衡，分层定位。
text.en: ByteDance Doubao: balanced Chinese and multimodality, tiered by use.

text.zh: 百度文心：中文知识与检索增强强。
text.en: Baidu ERNIE: strong Chinese knowledge and retrieval augmentation.

text.zh: 腾讯混元：中文与 Agent 场景均衡。
text.en: Tencent Hunyuan: balanced for Chinese and agent scenarios.

text.zh: Mistral 代码专用：补全与生成。
text.en: Mistral coding specialist for completion and generation.

text.zh: Mistral：宽松许可，欧洲开源权重代表。
text.en: Mistral: permissively licensed European open-weight line.

text.zh: Meta Llama 开源权重模型。
text.en: Meta Llama open-weight model.

text.zh: Cohere Command：企业检索与工具调用见长。
text.en: Cohere Command: strong at enterprise retrieval and tool use.

text.zh: 微软 Phi 小模型：体积小、可本地部署。
text.en: Microsoft Phi small model: compact and locally deployable.

text.zh: Amazon Nova 模型。
text.en: Amazon Nova model.

text.zh: Perplexity Sonar：联网检索增强。
text.en: Perplexity Sonar: search-augmented.

text.en: Lightweight tier: fast and cheap, for simple or high-frequency tasks.

text.zh: 高能力档：适合复杂或质量优先的任务，成本更高。
text.en: High-capability tier: for complex, quality-first work at higher cost.
